attchmntText: Singer India Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Singer India Limited published un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The Board approved the results on 12th November 2026. Sabrimala Industries India Limited also published un-audited financial results for the same period. The Board approved these results on 10th November 2026. Automobile Corporation of Goa Limited issued a postal ballot notice. The notice seeks shareholder approval for the appointment of Ms. Swao Shivanand Salgaocar as a Non-Executive Independent Director. The remote e-voting period runs from 16th November 2026 to 15th December 2026. MBL Infrastructure Ltd. issued a postal ballot notice. The notice seeks shareholder approval for resolutions set forth in the notice. The remote e-voting period runs from 16th November 2026 to 15th December 2026.

attchmntText: Singer India Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Singer India Limited reported financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. Revenue for Q2 reached INR 185.2 Crores, a 34.3% year-over-year increase. Half-year revenue stood at INR 329.8 Crores, up 43.4%. Q2 EBITDA was INR 10.9 Crores, rising 85.4%, while PAT was INR 6.9 Crores, up 81.2%. For H1, EBITDA grew 371.1% to INR 16.4 Crores, and PAT surged 576.2% to INR 9.9 Crores. The company has zero debt. Market capitalization was INR 4.80 billion as of 30th September 2026. Shares are listed on the BSE and NSE. The board includes Rakesh Khanna as Vice Chairman and Managing Director.

attchmntText: Singer India Limited has informed the Exchange about related Party Transactions
voiceSummary: Singer India Limited filed a disclosure of related party transactions for the half year ended 30th September 2026. The total value of transactions during the reporting period is 416.71. Transactions include remuneration and employee share based payment expenses for Vice Chairman and Managing Director Rakesh Khanna. Chief Financial Officer Anuj Kumar Vasdev received remuneration and share based payment expenses. Company Secretary and Compliance Officer Rupinder Kaur received remuneration. Non Executive Non Independent Director Hetal Madhukant Gandhi received reimbursement of expenses and share based payment expenses. Non Executive Independent Directors Maneesh Mansingka, Hemant Sachdev, Rajesh Relan, and Sunil Duggal received share based payment expenses or sitting fees. The details are available on the company website.

attchmntText: Singer India Limited has informed the Exchange about statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
desc: Statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
voiceSummary: Singer India Limited confirms no deviation or variation in the utilization of proceeds from its Preferential Issue for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The funds were raised on December 29, 2025, totaling Rs. 4,48,55,173.02. The statement was reviewed by the Audit Committee. Funds raised were allocated for expansion of manufacturing facilities and issue expenses. Rs. 289.83 lacs were utilized for manufacturing expansion against an allocation of Rs. 436.55 lacs. Rs. 10.97 lacs were utilized for issue expenses against an allocation of Rs. 12.00 lacs. Total funds utilized amount to Rs. 300.80 lacs. No deviation or variation is reported. This disclosure is hosted on the company website.

Singer India Limited board approved unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Revenue from operations was 18,520 lakhs for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, compared to 13,790 lakhs in the same period last year. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, revenue was 32,975 lakhs. Profit before tax stood at 936 lakhs for the quarter and 1,340 lakhs for the half year. Basic earnings per share were 1.12 rupees for the quarter and 1.60 rupees for the half year. The company recorded a one-time impact of 73 lakhs due to new labour codes. Total assets as at September 30, 2026, were 30,336 lakhs. The meeting was held on November 12, 2026.
